pppd.exe Windows 0.4.0 - source provenance

Base: ppp-project/ppp, pppd 2.5.5,
commit 4dc474cacfa045d1ee1b10c388d8c864e3ed3b30.
https://github.com/ppp-project/ppp/tree/4dc474cacfa045d1ee1b10c388d8c864e3ed3b30

The original protocol machines and algorithms are retained for FSM, LCP,
IPCP, IPv6CP/EUI64, PAP, CHAP-MD5, MSCHAPv1/v2, EAP, EAP-TLS, PEAP client
CBCP client and CCP. CORE-PROVENANCE.txt and AUTH-PROVENANCE.txt identify the
extracted upstream functions, host adaptations and demonstrated corrections.
Those files also describe upstream limitations; this is not a complete Linux
pppd or kernel port.

LCP Echo periodic/adaptive scheduling and RTT measurement are included.
IPCP address/DNS/WINS negotiation and IPv6CP use native Windows host callbacks.
Authentication is completed before NCPs or IP data are allowed. No simulated
success is used for an unavailable authentication or packet-processing engine.

pppd-private.h, pppdconf.h, auth_port.c and engine.c provide the Windows host
contract. Async framing/FCS, queues, clocks, COM, IPC, Wintun and IP Helper
integration are host code. platform_network.inc configures owned IPv4/IPv6
resources, DNS and optional IPv4 default routes. It also preserves the
negotiated IPv6CP source selection and restores original automatic-address
flags on teardown. These platform adapters are not copied Linux kernel code.

CCP negotiation and data processing now use retained pppd CCP and userspace
adaptations of Linux VJ, BSD-Compress, PPP Deflate/zlib and MPPE codecs.
The per-codec provenance records identify original sources, hashes, adaptations
and notices. MPPE key derivation remains in pppd/mppe.c; packet encryption is
in src/mppe_port.c and vendor/mppe-codec. Multilink is not implemented.
CBCP requests a callback from the peer and exits14; there is no Windows modem dialer.

The command catalogue lists supported, limited and unavailable options. Unix
scripts, PAM/systemd integration, Linux binary plugins and alternative kernel
transports are not claimed. TLS uses statically linked OpenSSL3.5.9; its license
is provided in OPENSSL-LICENSE.txt. Protocol notices are preserved in source
headers and LICENCES.txt. Wintun has its separate WINTUN-LICENSE.txt.
